answer: An answer must include the first 24 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the ferrous derivation is checked against the zenith nonce, the mirror audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 163 aliases produces 163 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
